aiSearch.title: Search with natural language
aiSearch.description: Describe what you are looking for and the assistant will surface drives, charging sessions, and alerts that match — citing each entity by name.

tooShort.title: Type at least 2 characters
tooShort.message: Search across vehicles, drives, charging sessions, alerts, geofences, automations and more.

empty.title: Start typing to search
empty.message: Search across vehicles, drives, charging sessions, alerts, geofences, automations and more.

error.title: Search failed
error.message: The search service did not respond. Try again or refine your query.

noResults.title: No results
noResults.message: No matches for "{{query}}". Try fewer characters or open the command palette.

connect.title: Connect Tesla account
connect.desc: Authorize TeslaSync to access your Tesla account.

refreshToken.title: Tesla refresh token
refreshToken.desc: Manually refresh the cached Tesla OAuth token.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Tesla account
disconnect.desc: Sign out and remove the cached OAuth token.

syncVehicles.title: Sync vehicles from Tesla
syncVehicles.desc: Pull the current vehicle list from the Tesla Fleet API.

region.title: Region & Fleet API endpoint
region.desc: Tesla account region and the resolved Fleet API base URL.

features.title: Feature flags
features.desc: Tesla account feature configuration synced from the Fleet API.

orders.title: Active orders
orders.desc: Vehicle orders and delivery tracking from Tesla.

distance.title: Distance unit
distance.desc: Show distances in kilometers or miles.

temperature.title: Temperature unit
temperature.desc: Show temperatures in Celsius or Fahrenheit.

pressure.title: Tire pressure unit
pressure.desc: Show tire pressure in Bar or PSI.

range.title: Preferred range
range.desc: Display rated or ideal range for the battery.

precision.title: Decimal precision
precision.desc: Number of decimal places shown on numeric metrics.

currency.title: Currency
currency.desc: Currency symbol used in cost and savings displays.

locale.title: Number & date locale
locale.desc: Locale used for number, date, and time formatting.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.desc: Whether timestamps follow the vehicle, your local time, or UTC.

electricityCost.title: Electricity cost (per kWh)
electricityCost.desc: Per-kWh price used in charging cost calculations.

gasPriceManual.title: Comparison gas price
gasPriceManual.desc: Manual gas price used in EV-vs-ICE savings comparisons.

mpg.title: Comparison vehicle MPG
mpg.desc: Average MPG of the equivalent gas car for savings calculations.

gasPrice.title: Gas price auto-poll
gasPrice.desc: Automatically fetch US average gas prices from EIA.

browser.title: Browser notifications
browser.desc: Enable browser notifications when the tab is in the background.

alerts.title: Alert notifications
alerts.desc: Get notified when an alert rule fires.

exportStatus.title: Export completion notifications
exportStatus.desc: Get notified when a CSV/JSON export finishes.

tabBadge.title: Browser tab unread badge
tabBadge.desc: Show unread count in the browser tab title and favicon.

criticalFlash.title: Critical alert tab flash
criticalFlash.desc: Flash the browser tab title on critical alerts.

soundMaster.title: Notification sounds
soundMaster.desc: Play short audio cues when alerts and completion events arrive.

soundChannels.title: Per-channel notification sounds
soundChannels.desc: Toggle sound separately for critical, warning, and info alerts plus charge/drive/automation completions.

soundVolume.title: Notification sound volume
soundVolume.desc: Adjust how loud notification cues play.

windows.title: Quiet hours windows
windows.desc: Defer non-critical notifications during sleep, work meetings, or any time-of-day window.

bypass.title: Quiet hours bypass severities
bypass.desc: Choose which severities (e.g. critical) still ring through during quiet hours.

timezone.title: Quiet hours timezone
timezone.desc: Pick the IANA timezone the start/end times are evaluated against.

theme.title: Theme
theme.desc: Choose light, dark, or system mode and pick an accent color.

density.title: Information density
density.desc: Compact, comfortable, or spacious row sizing across tables and cards.

timeFormat.title: Default time format
timeFormat.desc: Show timestamps as relative ("2h ago") or absolute ("Nov 12, 13:42").

chartPalette.title: Chart palette
chartPalette.desc: Color-blind safe (Okabe-Ito) or stylistic neon chart colors.

statusBar.title: Status bar
statusBar.desc: Show or hide the always-on footer status bar.

celebrations.title: Achievement celebrations
celebrations.desc: Celebration toasts and sound when an achievement unlocks.

restoreConfirms.title: Restore confirmation prompts
restoreConfirms.desc: Re-enable “Don’t ask again” prompts you previously silenced.

export.title: Export settings as JSON
export.desc: Download a portable bundle of general settings, alert rules, geofences, and quiet-hours windows.

import.title: Import settings from JSON
import.desc: Restore alert rules, geofences, and quiet-hours windows from a previously exported bundle.
